mapper.select: SELECT B.BOARD_ID AS boardId, B.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, B.BOARD_CONTENT AS boardContent, B.BOARD_VIEW_COUNT AS boardViewCount, B.BOARD_CREATE AS boardCreate, B.BOARD_TYPE_ID AS boardTypeId, B.IS_ANONYMOUS_YN AS isAnonymousYn, M.NICKNAME, S.SNACK_ID AS snackId, S.DETAILS, S.BLOOD_SUGAR_F AS bloodSugarF, S.BLOOD_SUGAR_S AS bloodSugarS, S.FASTING_GLU AS fastingGlu, S.EXER, S.TASTERATING FROM "BOARD" B JOIN "MEMBER" M ON (B.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) LEFT JOIN "SNACK" S ON (B.BOARD_ID = S.BOARD_ID) -- 간식 정보가 있으면 가져오고 없으면 NULL WHERE B.BOARD_DELETED_FL = 'N' ORDER BY B.BOARD_ID DESC

SELECT B.BOARD_ID AS boardId, B.BOARD_TITLE AS boardTitle, B.BOARD_CONTENT AS boardContent, B.BOARD_VIEW_COUNT AS boardViewCount, B.BOARD_CREATE AS boardCreate, S.SNACK_ID AS snackId, S.DETAILS, S.BLOOD_SUGAR_F AS bloodSugarF, S.BLOOD_SUGAR_S AS bloodSugarS, S.FASTING_GLU AS fastingGlu, S.EXER, S.TASTERATING FROM "BOARD" B /* 수정 포인트: MEMBER_ID가 아닌 BOARD_ID로 조인해야 정확한 게시글 상세 정보가 매칭됩니다 */ JOIN "SNACK" S ON (B.BOARD_ID = S.BOARD_ID) WHERE B.BOARD_DELETED_FL = 'N' AND B.BOARD_TYPE_ID = 2 ORDER BY B.BOARD_ID DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_BOARD_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO "BOARD" ( BOARD_ID, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CONTENT, MEMBER_ID, BOARD_TYPE_ID, BOARD_CREATE ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{memberId}, 2, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO "SNACK" ( SNACK_ID, BOARD_ID, MEMBER_ID, DETAILS, BLOOD_SUGAR_F, BLOOD_SUGAR_S, FASTING_GLU, EXER, TASTERATING ) VALUES ( SEQ_SNACK_ID.NEXTVAL, #{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{details}, #{bloodSugarF}, #{bloodSugarS}, #{fastingGlu}, #{exer}, #{tasterating} )
